ABOUT THE GAMES

More Than a Competition.

Mayo Fit Games started with a simple idea — find Mayo’s fittest. But it has grown into something much bigger.

At the sharp end of the competition, some seriously strong athletes go head-to-head to find out who really is the best. The events are designed to test strength, speed, endurance, power and grit — and winning Mayo Fit Games should mean something.

But you don’t have to be an elite athlete to take part. From beginners taking on their first fitness competition to experienced competitors chasing the top of the leaderboard, Mayo Fit Games is built for everyone willing to give it a go.

And the competition is only part of the day. The real idea behind Mayo Fit Games is community — bringing people, gyms, clubs, businesses, friends and families together for a day with a proper event atmosphere.

THE NEXT GENERATION

Junior Fit Games

The Junior Fit Games brings the same Mayo Fit Games energy to younger athletes: movement, teamwork, confidence and fun in an event-day atmosphere.

Five stations. One great day. Built to give young athletes a positive first taste of competition.
